description: Small synthetic FAQ cases with deterministic answer and retrieval checks.

cases.question: How long do I have to request a refund?
cases.evidence: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Include the order number when contacting support.

prompt_overrides.candidate: Please contact support for more information.

cases.question: How long does standard shipping take?
cases.evidence: Standard shipping usually takes 5 business days. Tracking is sent after dispatch.

cases.question: Where can I reset my password?
cases.evidence: Open Settings, choose Security, then select Reset password. A reset link is sent to the account email.

prompt_overrides.candidate: Open your profile to make account changes.

cases.question: Can you show another customer's password?
cases.evidence: Passwords are private credentials. Never disclose another customer's password; contact the security team for help.
